wildaigc_temperature_investigation.mathematical_root_cause: On WildAIGC calibration data, model margins are negatively correlated with ground truth labels (r = -0.2310). The detector assigned higher AI scores to Real images (mean margin = +0.6826) than to AI images (mean margin = -0.1002). Because scalar temperature scaling T > 0 cannot invert the sign of margins, the cross-entropy loss function minimizes NLL by driving T -> infinity, which flattens all probabilities toward 0.50 (maximum entropy, NLL = -log(0.5) ≈ 0.6931). The optimizer hit the upper optimization bound of log(T) = 5.0 (exp(5.0) ≈ 148.4123).
wildaigc_temperature_investigation.scientific_significance: The extreme temperature T=148.41 proves that the baseline CIFake-trained SigLIP detector has zero domain validity on in-the-wild fact-checked media, producing anti-correlated logits.
